## Details

<a id="main_loop"></a>
### [`main_loop`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L6) `$4349`

*label*

Main loop. Stops the plane after a crash, handles the pause and the F7 and F3 keys, draws the status line and the airfield distance, then loops.
